usage: deskops atoms create [-h]
                            --five-wh-one-plus {what,why,how,how_not,when,where,for_whom}
                            [--title TITLE] [--tag TAG [TAG ...]]
                            (--from-pill PILL_ID |
                            --from-graph SOURCE_ID->TARGET_ID |
                            --from-diagram SPEC_PATH) [--graph GRAPH]
                            [--root ROOT]
                            doc_id

positional arguments:
  doc_id                New atom id to create, conventionally atom-<slug>.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --five-wh-one-plus {what,why,how,how_not,when,where,for_whom}
                        The single 5WH1+ question this atom answers.
  --title TITLE         Optional title override for the created atom.
  --tag TAG [TAG ...]   Atom tag to add; repeat or space-separate as needed.
  --from-pill PILL_ID   Create the atom from one pill field chosen by --five-
                        wh-one-plus.
  --from-graph SOURCE_ID->TARGET_ID
                        Create the atom from one missing graph finding
                        resolved by source and target ids.
  --from-diagram SPEC_PATH
                        Create the atom from one diagram source file such as
                        docs/diagrams/example/source.mmd.
  --graph GRAPH         Optional graph snapshot path consulted in addition to
                        declared-edge findings when resolving --from-graph.
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
